ters. Here, we use the Dynamically Simple Model of Atmo-
Evans, 2009) to estimate the sensitivity of OH to chemi-

processor (KPP) to generate the FORTRAN code for a cho-
sen chemical mechanism. In this study, the DSMACC model
is compiled with MOZART-4 and GEOS-Chem chemical

ated 3D models CESM1–CAM4Chem and GEOSCCM. The

by the CESM1–CAM4Chem and GEOSCCM or generated
from observations, and the diurnal cycle of the photolysis

is run forward until reaching the diurnal steady state of OH.
